'''Maya''' (Japanese: '''マヤ''' ''Maya'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|GS}}. She is a Sea Priestess of the [[Whirl Islands]].

Maya is responsible for keeping the culture and tradition of the [[Whirl Cup]] alive. Like generations of great {{cat|Water-type Trainers}} before her, she oversees the Whirl Cup competition with the magical power of the [[Sea Spirit|Great Sea Spirit Sapphire]]. It is said that she can communicate with {{type|Water}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} when she evokes the Sea Spirit Union.

She watched over the Whirl Cup in ''[[EP216|Dueling Heroes]]'' and ''[[EP217|The Perfect Match!]]''. Maya is very confident, as was proven when [[Officer Jenny]] warned her that the Sea Spirit was about to be stolen. Maya smiled and told the officer not to worry about what may happen.
